recommendation: Keep the human-review audit until CQI/FHIR-I decide whether FHIR-55436 remains Applied/Persuasive or is reopened/not persuasive. If removal stands, clean up active Measure examples and regenerated narrative consistently; if reversal is approved, restore Measure.topic and the related search/rendering artifacts through the normal source-generation path.
issue_request: FHIR-55436 requested removal of deprecated Measure.topic in R6 as a CQI child ticket of the broader deprecated-element cleanup in FHIR-53722.
initial_application: Git commit 06ab81280ad55b6232b7acf245ed9fbc014b41d4 removed Measure.topic from source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml, removed the Measure-topic search parameter, updated source/measure/measure.svg, and added the Measure introduction note. Active Measure examples still contain <topic> elements.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini and current source has no Measure.topic element or Measure-topic search parameter. However, a 2026-05-26 comment on FHIR-55436 says the topic removals were identified as incorrect because topic is about artifact subject matter while useContext is about contexts of appropriate use, and proposes reopening the issue as not persuasive and undoing the change. FHIR-55564 carries the same later concern for related CDS topic removals; FHIR-38841 is the Published R5 deprecation decision that originally recommended migration to useContext.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Completing removal by deleting topic from active examples, or reversing removal by restoring Measure.topic and related artifacts, would require a work-group decision that is not yet reflected in Jira status.
